reason: The batch report with a named lab is what I always look for, and the box number matching it is a real check. $24.99 for one box is a price I can risk, and the empty-box refund covers me if it does nothing.
objection: I haven't seen the lab report yet, so I don't know if it's real or just a nice claim. After the launch price ends, $29.99 a month is a lot on my income.
would_change_my_mind: If the lab report for the batch turned out not to be on the page or the QR code didn't work, I would not buy.
